jobs.title: Backend Technical Lead - Node js,Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma, REST
jobs.description:
**Role description** **Who we are:**



At UST, we help the world’s best organizations grow and succeed through transformation. Bringing together the right talent, tools, and ideas, we work with our client to co\-create lasting change. Together, with over 30,000 employees in 30\+ countries, we build for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process. Visit us at UST.com.


**Summary:**



We are looking for a hands\-on Backend Developer Lead to own the API and service layer of a large\-scale geospatial platform built on Next.js, tRPC and PostgreSQL/PostGIS, running on Google Cloud Run.
This is a modular monolith, not a microservices estate:
* A documented route manager engine repository architecture
* Wired with Inversify dependency injection
* Across 11 PostgreSQL schemas and 69 data models

The role demands genuine depth:
* You will complete an unfinished authorisation refactor
* Finish a streaming\-export programme
* Resolve a dual\-ORM strategy
* Clear a significant security remediation backlog
* All in a 65,000\-line codebase with only 9 test files

The ideal candidate is a strong backend engineer who is comfortable owning technical design and leading a team while remaining predominantly hands\-on.
**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the hands\-on design and development of the API and service layer using TypeScript, Next.js, tRPC 11 and Zod.
* Own 17 tRPC routers and 17 REST route handlers, and the layered architecture behind them: managers, engines and repositories wired with Inversify.
* Complete the unified authorisation refactor currently unfinished across open merge requests. Make server\-side authorisation authoritative and treat UI checks as convenience only.
* Own PostgreSQL 16 \+ PostGIS 3\.5 across 11 schemas: schema design, indexing, query plans, and transaction boundaries.
* Resolve the dual\-ORM strategy: Prisma owns 128 migrations, Drizzle owns 11, both targeting the same database.
* Publish and enforce an ownership map per bounded context.
* Own the import pipeline: 14 import.\* staging tables converted into live schemas under transaction, including plan survey, personal plan and plan spend imports.
* Complete the streaming CSV export programme across five bulk export routes, preserving correct backpressure (ReadableStream with pull()) and cursor\-based pagination. No loading whole datasets into memory.
* Clear the security remediation backlog: 182 findings including 15 critical and 49 high, covering dependency advisories, an SSRF in application code, and secret rotation.
* Own authentication and session via NextAuth 4 and Okta/OIDC, including permission utilities and organisation/group scoping.
* Integrate Google Cloud services: Cloud Storage across 8 buckets, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Secret Manager, and GCP logging.
* Establish backend test coverage where almost none exists: a database\-backed integration harness, plus unit tests on permissions, geometry, subscriptions and export engines.
* Set and enforce backend engineering standards: coding conventions, code review, testing, and documentation.
* Champion the effective use of AI\-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT) to accelerate delivery and raise code quality.
* Own backend non\-functional quality: performance, scalability, resilience, observability, and security.
* Identify and pay down technical debt across oversized routers:
* + organization\-router.ts: 1,102 lines
	+ plan\-router.ts: 994
	+ import\-router.ts: 815
* Collaborate with Frontend, Architecture, QA and DevOps to deliver business outcomes.
* Mentor backend engineers and support technical growth.
* Would be responsible for L2 and L3 support and on call during off business hours.

**Required Skills \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 8\+ years of backend software development experience, including 2\+ years leading a team or squad technically.
* Deep expertise in TypeScript and Node.js in production.
* Strong experience with tRPC or a comparable typed RPC layer: routers, procedures, middleware, and the typed client/server contract.
* Strong experience with Next.js server\-side: route handlers, App Router API design, instrumentation.ts, and standalone output.
* Zod or equivalent runtime validation at the API boundary.
* Deep PostgreSQL: schema design, indexing strategy, query plans, and transaction isolation.
* You should read EXPLAIN ANALYZE comfortably.
* Experience with multi\-schema PostgreSQL: search paths, cross\-schema foreign keys, and permissions.
* Strong ORM experience: Prisma and/or Drizzle, including migration strategy and the judgement to run two ORMs safely side by side.
* Node streams / Web Streams: genuine understanding of backpressure, not just piping.
* Dependency injection in a JavaScript/TypeScript runtime: Inversify or equivalent, including lifecycle and scoping in a serverless runtime.
* Layered architecture discipline: thin routes, orchestrating managers, domain engines, persistence\-only repositories.
* Authentication and authorisation at implementation level: OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, session management, and permission modelling.
* Application security fundamentals: OWASP Top 10, SSRF defence, secrets management, dependency advisory remediation.
* Testing with Vitest, including database\-backed integration testing.
* Practical, day\-to\-day use of AI\-assisted engineering tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT or similar).
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**
* PostGIS in production: geometry types, spatial indexes, SRID handling, and validity.
* Coordinate reference systems and reprojection (proj4, ST\_Transform): this product handles EPSG:27700, 29901 and 23030\.
* Google Cloud Platform: Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, Secret Manager, Artifact Registry.
* NextAuth 4 with an enterprise OIDC provider (Okta).
* Streaming exports at scale (100k\+ rows) and cursor\-based pagination.

jobs.description:
**About Providence**
--------------------


Providence, one of the US’s largest not\-for\-profit healthcare systems, is committed to high quality, compassionate healthcare for all. Driven by the belief that health is a human right and the vision, ‘Health for a better world’, Providence and its 121,000 caregivers strive to provide everyone access to affordable quality care and services.


Providence has a network of 51 hospitals, 1,000\+ care clinics, senior services, supportive housing, and other health and educational services in the US.


Providence India is bringing to fruition the transformational shift of the healthcare ecosystem to Health 2\.0\. The India center will have focused efforts around healthcare technology and innovation, and play a vital role in driving digital transformation of health systems for improved patient outcomes and experiences, caregiver efficiency, and running the business of Providence at scale.

  

**Why Us?**
-----------

* Best In\-class Benefits
* Inclusive Leadership
* Reimagining Healthcare
* Competitive Pay
* Supportive Reporting Relation
**How is this team contributing to vision of Providence?**


We specialize in developing technological solutions that streamline and enhance every aspect of healthcare delivery. Our approach revolves around prioritizing the patient and provider, ensuring they are at the heart of all our innovations. By leveraging the most promising ideas and insights gleaned from healthcare experts, we are dedicated to crafting seamless experiences that benefit care facilities and their patients alike. This commitment drives us forward in our mission of "Health for a better world."


**What will you be responsible for?**


* Design, develop, and maintain advanced software solutions using .NET, Python, integrating and optimizing Language Model frameworks for various applications.
* Apply Object\-Oriented Principles, algorithms, and debugging techniques to ensure robust and scalable code solutions.
* Utilize version control systems (e.g., Git) proficiently to manage source code and collaborate effectively within a team environment.
* Implement Coding Design Patterns and adhere to SOLID Principles to promote code maintainability, scalability, and reusability.
* Develop and execute comprehensive unit tests using frameworks like pytest /unittest/NUnit to validate functionality and performance.
* Lead and contribute to Agile practices, including sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, and retrospectives, ensuring timely delivery of high\-quality software.
* Collaborate closely with stakeholders including product managers, data scientists, and UX/UI designers to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Provide technical leadership in software design and architecture, ensuring adherence to best practices and scalability
* Stay updated with the latest advancements in Language Model frameworks and contribute to their integration and enhancement within our software ecosystem.

**What would your week look like?**


* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including product managers, designers, and developers to deliver high\-quality software solutions.

**Who we are looking for?**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 5 \- 8 years of professional experience in software development with a strong emphasis on **C\#.NET, Python** and proficiency in **LLM frameworks** such as LangChain.
* Solid understanding of **RAG, fine tuning techniques, building AI agents**
* Working knowledge of foundation models like Claude/OpenAI, **Vector store**
* Excellent communication skills and ability to manage stakeholders, ensuring alignment of technical solutions with business goals.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail in software design and architecture.
* Previous experience mentoring junior engineers and guiding technical decisions.
* Very good at Vibe coding and rapid development
  
Providence’s vision to create ‘Health for a Better World’ aids us to provide a fair and equitable workplace for all in our employment, whether temporary, part\-time or full time, and to promote individuality and diversity of thought and background, and acknowledge its role in the organization’s success. This makes us committed towards equal employment opportunities, regardless of race, religion or belief, color, ancestry, disability, marital status, gender, sexual orientation, age, nationality, ethnic origin, pregnancy, or related needs, mental or sensory disability, HIV Status, or any other category protected by applicable law. In furtherance to our mission in building a more inclusive and equitable environment, we shall, from time to time, undertake programs to assist, uplift and empower underrepresented groups including but not limited to Women, PWD (Persons with Disabilities), LGTBQ\+ (Lesbian, Gay, Transgender, Bisexual or Queer), Veterans and others. We strive to address all forms of discrimination or harassment and provide a safe and confidential process to report any misconduct.


Contact our Integrity hotline also, read our Code of Conduct.

jobs.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end\-to\-end, 0 to 1, etc).
* 2 years of experience developing/launching products/technologies within one or more of the following: Cloud, SaaS, enterprise, internal tools, or supply chain networks.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with Quote\-to\-Cash, Ordering, Fulfillment or Supply Chain Product Management.
* Experience in Platform Product Management.
* Knowledge of Ordering and Fulfillment Processes and Systems for Hardware or Software.
* Strong product management, business acumen, investigative, and stakeholder management skills, with exceptional attention to detail.
* Strong problem solving, data analysis and business judgment skills.

**About the job**
-----------------


At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  

  

In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  

  

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  


The OREO (Ordering, Entitlements and Obligations) team powers Google Cloud's commercial success by managing order booking and product fulfillment orchestration. Part of GCBP (Google Cloud Business Platform), we are modernizing the Quote\-to\-Cash life\-cycle—from ordering and provisioning to billing—ensuring data quality across Cloud's financial, sales compensation, and transaction systems. We offer a collaborative, culture focused on major architectural upgrades and high\-stakes initiatives.


As a team member, you will manage the migration to Cloud's automated booking and orchestration platform, launching new agreement types, products, and Go\-To\-Market (GTM) motions to reshape the post\-agreement experience for customers and internal teams. We provide growth opportunities, empowering Product Managers to direct high\-visibility programs and strategic integrations alongside talented peers. Join us to solve tests and impact Google Cloud's commerce platform.


Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead the product roadmap for core ordering systems, modernizing and automating Google Cloud's Quote\-to\-Cash life\-cycle across offline and online flows.
* Design and execute end\-to\-end orchestration workflows for product provisioning and manage platform primitives for entitlement life\-cycles and usage integration metrics.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment with engineering, sales operations, and boundary product groups to support commercial transaction flows and downstream systems like sales compensation, billing, and business recognition.
* Serve as the Subject Matter Expert and advocate for process/system discipline in ordering, booking, and fulfillment for your supported line of business.
* Lead end\-to\-end initiatives across Quote\-to\-Cash and GCBP overall.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

**We're looking for a**
**Product Manager \- HR Technology**
====================================


**This role is** **Office Based, Hyderabad Office****Product Manager \| Enterprise SaaS \- B2B \| Hyderabad \| Hybrid**
  

  

**About Cornerstone**
  

Cornerstone powers the future of workforce readiness. Our platform helps organizations understand the skills they have, the skills they need, and the fastest path between the two — combining learning, talent development, and workforce intelligence in one system.
  

We serve approximately 7,000 organizations and more than 140 million users across 186 countries, backed by two decades of workforce data and a skills taxonomy spanning 55,000\+ skills. Our India teams in Pune and Bengaluru are core product and engineering centers, not support satellites — the work you own here ships to global enterprise customers.
  

**The role in one paragraph**
  

You will own a product area end to end: the problems it solves, the roadmap that gets there, and the outcomes it produces. You'll work daily with engineering squads, a designer, and stakeholders across sales, customer success, and support. This is a builder's role — we expect you to form your own point of view on what to build, defend it with evidence, and be accountable for whether it worked

jobs.title: Product Management Advisor - HIH - Evernorth
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**
 The Agile Product Owner Advisor is a strategic and collaborative leader within an agile development team, responsible for managing the product backlog and ensuring that development efforts align with customer needs and business goals. This role involves translating high\-level business requirements into clear, actionable features, defining acceptance criteria, and prioritizing work to maximize value delivery. The Product Owner serves as the voice of the customer, working closely with developers, architects, operations, and business stakeholders to guide product development through iterative cycles.
   

  

 The Product Owner should embrace the “Product Mindset” and is expected to understand strategic roadmap goals, conduct customer interviews, analyze data, and participate in portfolio discussions to shape the product vision. They are empowered to support intake, prioritize delivery in partnership with business and Engineering, and ensure the Scrum team is focused on solving the right problems with innovative solutions. This role demands strong business and technical acumen, the ability to communicate effectively across teams, and a commitment to delivering measurable outcomes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Understand and align product goals with strategic business objectives to ensure delivery of meaningful value.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with business and technology partners, fostering cross\-functional collaboration.
* Act as the primary contact for resolving escalations, removing impediments, and managing stakeholder negotiations and conflicts.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to onboard new initiatives and integrate them effectively into the product development lifecycle.
* Support the development of specifications, including value propositions and technical financial estimates, to guide delivery planning.
* Align with delivery teams to understand capacity and ensure prioritization is accurately reflected in the product backlog.
* Own and refine the product backlog, maintaining a steady flow of well\-defined work items for the development team.
* Analyze business needs and support requirement gathering, architecture discussions, and design decisions within agile teams.
* Translate business requirements into actionable features and define iteration scope to guide development.
* Participate actively in agile ceremonies and respond to team inquiries, clarifying features and acceptance criteria.
* Communicate the product vision and strategic decisions to the team, reinforcing customer\-centric thinking and business rationale.
* Conduct data analysis and profiling to support product decisions, including mapping source\-to\-target data and investigating issues using tools like SQL, SAS, or Python


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in MIS, Business, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 11\-13 years of experience in data analysis; Healthcare data domain experience and Agile certification (e.g., SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager) are highly desirable.
* Demonstrated experience as a Product Owner or in a similar role within Agile development environments, with a strong grasp of Agile principles, Scrum methodology, and modern delivery practices such as continuous integration and test\-driven development.
* Proven ability to translate complex business needs into clear, actionable features and acceptance criteria, with a focus on delivering customer\-centric solutions.
* Aptitude for gaining deep knowledge of the industry, business strategy, and key data domains (e.g., provider data, claims, membership, benefits), and proactively applying this knowledge to drive meaningful results.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship management skills, with the ability to facilitate collaboration across multiple functions, departments, and levels.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills, with the ability to influence and negotiate effectively across technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Proficiency in Agile and collaboration tools (JIRA) with hands\-on experience supporting agile ceremonies and backlog management.
* Advanced data analysis capabilities, including experience with SQL tools (e.g.,Toad, SAS, Alation), and data profiling techniques; familiarity with cloud technologies and data warehousing is a plus.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to investigate code, decode data issues, and support architecture and design decisions.
* Exceptional organizational and work management skills, with experience managing dependencies, risks, and delivery timelines in dynamic, lean/agile environments.


**Required Skills**
* Data Analytics Platforms (Databricks and/or Snowflake)
* Python, DevOps, Basic Cloud Experience (AWS/Azure)
* SQL


**Preferred Skills, Experience \& Education**
* Cloud Certification (AWS Cloud Practitioner or similar)


**Equal Opportunity Statement**
*Evernorth is an Equal Opportunity Employer actively encouraging and supporting organization\-wide involvement of staff in diversity, equity, and inclusion efforts to educate, inform and advance both internal practices and external work with diverse client populations.*
  

  

  

  

**About Evernorth Health Services**
 Evernorth Health Services, a division of The Cigna Group, creates pharmacy, care and benefit solutions to improve health and increase vitality. We relentlessly innovate to make the prediction, prevention and treatment of illness and disease more accessible to millions of people. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

**About The Role And Team**
 Product at Uber means making big decisions without perfect information\-and owning the outcomes. As a Senior Product Manager (Tech), you will turn massive complexity into clarity at speed, navigating the "messy" reality of multi\-sided marketplaces and high\-stakes technical integrations. You will be at the heart of our most ambitious missions, architecting solutions that bridge the digital and physical worlds for millions of users globally.
   

  

 This is a high\-visibility, high\-impact role where you won't just manage a roadmap; you will build 0\-to\-1 platforms that bridge the digital and physical worlds. You'll need to lead through influence, not control, and stay resilient while balancing the needs of external partners, engineering teams, and global business units. If you are a curious, owner\-minded product leader who is energized by challenge and motivated by real\-world impact\-this is where you'll grow.
   

  

**What You'll Do**

* Design and ship scalable technology solutions\-including APIs, orchestration layers, and developer tools\-to deeply interpret and respond to complex marketplace signals.
* Navigate and align cross\-functional teams across Engineering, Data Science, Design, and Legal to drive cohesive product strategies despite competing priorities.
* Translate unstructured user pain points into clear product requirements by distilling complex problems, writing hypotheses, and defining measurable outcomes.
* Forge and manage strategic relationships with external partners, fintechs, or autonomous technology providers to scale deployments and optimize global operations.
* Iterate relentlessly by distilling insights from performance dashboards, experimentation results, and user research to continuously raise the bar for quality and reliability.

* 6 \+ years of experience as a Product Manager, with a proven track record of shipping large\-scale projects each quarter that yield quantifiable impact.
* Proven ability to convert unstructured problems with significant ambiguity into clarifying, focused plans for multi\-team projects.
* Strong technical depth: Able to coordinate large engineering efforts, identify potential technical risks, and act as an effective partner for engineering managers across teams.
* Experience defining OKRs and roadmaps for complex programs/platforms, ensuring teams operate with minimal noise and a rapid clip of high\-quality delivery.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Global experience: Building and launching products that bridge digital and physical worlds across diverse regional contexts.


**Ready to Ride?**
 This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook \- it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves \- we'd love to hear from you.

 Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in\-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full\-time in\-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.description:
**Internal Audit \| Data Strategy and Analytics \| Hyderabad**


Lead the architecture and delivery of scalable data capabilities that strengthen how Internal Audit sources, governs and uses data, while remaining hands\-on in engineering and developing the team.


WHAT WE DO


Internal Audit’s mission is to independently assess the firm’s internal control structure, including governance processes and controls, risk management, capital and anti\-financial crime frameworks. Internal Audit communicates on the effectiveness of governance, risk management and controls, raises awareness of control risk, assesses control culture and conduct risk, and monitors management’s implementation of control measures.


Data Strategy and Analytics (DSA) partners with audit teams to translate data needs into durable, reusable capabilities. The team designs data products, engineering patterns and AI\-ready data foundations that improve the efficiency, consistency and insight of audit work.


YOUR IMPACT


As a Vice President in DSA, you will combine architecture, hands\-on engineering, delivery leadership and mentoring. You will shape scalable data solutions for the third line of defence, set engineering standards and guide teams from problem definition through production delivery. You will work with auditors, engineers and data owners to ensure solutions are reliable, controlled and aligned to Internal Audit priorities.


RESPONSIBILITIES


* Own solution architecture and technical delivery for scalable data platforms, pipelines and curated data products supporting Internal Audit use cases.
* Translate audit and control objectives into pragmatic data designs, balancing delivery speed, reusability, performance, security and maintainability.
* Design and review data models for operational and analytical workloads, including dimensional models, slowly changing dimensions, lakehouse and data\-lake patterns.
* Remain hands\-on with Python and SQL, providing technical direction for implementations using Pandas, Polars and PySpark as appropriate to scale and workload
* Establish engineering standards for ETL/ELT design, testing, observability, data quality, lineage, documentation, version control and controlled production deployment.
* Guide the use of Snowflake and relational platforms such as DB2 and PostgreSQL, with clear expectations for workload design, performance and integration.
* Lead the design of AI\-ready data products and semantic layers that make governed data easier to discover, interpret and use in analytical and AI\-enabled solutions.
* Drive delivery across multiple stakeholders, communicate technical trade\-offs clearly, manage dependencies and escalate material risks promptly.
* Mentor engineers, strengthen design and code\-review practices, and contribute to hiring, capability development and an inclusive engineering culture.
* Build productive relationships with audit teams, technology partners, data owners and governance functions across the firm.
  

  

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS


* 7\+ years of relevant data engineering or software engineering experience, including technical leadership of complex data solutions.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in computer science, engineering or a related quantitative discipline. A master’s degree is welcome.
* Advanced, hands\-on proficiency in Python, including Pandas, Polars and PySpark, and strong software\-engineering practices.
* Advanced SQL proficiency and strong understanding of OLTP databases, relational design and query performance.
* Demonstrated expertise in data modelling, data warehousing, dimensional modelling and slowly changing dimensions.
* Experience designing ETL/ELT solutions and scalable data architectures across data lake, lakehouse or cloud data warehouse patterns.
* Ability to lead architecture and delivery while explaining technical choices, risks and trade\-offs to senior stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers, raise technical standards and coordinate delivery across teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication, sound judgement and the ability to manage multiple priorities

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS


* Experience architecting solutions on Snowflake and integrating data from DB2, PostgreSQL or comparable enterprise platforms.
* Experience with Spark\-based processing, orchestration frameworks, CI/CD, containers and cloud\-native delivery patterns.
* Experience designing governed semantic layers and AI\-ready data products, including metadata, access controls and reusable definitions.

Familiarity with data governance, privacy, security, retention, lineage and model\-risk considerations relevant to enterprise data. Experience in financial services, audit, risk or controls is helpful but not required.  
* 

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE


* Data solutions are scalable, controlled, well\-documented and reusable across audit teams.


* Engineering decisions are transparent, risk\-aware and supported by strong design and review practices.


* The team develops stronger technical capability, while stakeholders receive clear, dependable delivery.

jobs.description:
Overview:
**About the company**


Consilio stands as the global leader in eDiscovery, document review, flexible legal talent, and legal advisory \& transformation consulting services. With its Consilio Complete suite of capabilities, the company empowers multinational law firms and corporations using innovative software, cost\-effective managed services, and deep legal and regulatory industry expertise.

**Work Model** \- 3 days WFO/2 days WFH(Hybrid)**Shift** \- 2 PM \- 11 PM**Benefits** \- Free pick \& drop, free meals \& more  

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior SQL Engineer to join our Enterprise Data Warehouse team. This role will focus on advanced data analysis, prototype dataset development, data mart design, and investigative SQL work across enterprise source systems.
The ideal candidate is not simply a SQL developer. This person must have deep curiosity about data, strong analytical instincts, and the ability to determine whether query output “looks right” based on business context, source system behavior, data patterns, and reconciliation logic. This role requires someone who can work effectively even when documentation is incomplete or unavailable.
This position is expected to work closely with Data Engineering, Data Analysis, Business Systems Analysis, Product, and Engineering leadership. **Critical Success Factors**  

This role requires more than only years of SQL experience. The successful candidate must demonstrate:* Curiosity: Actively investigates data rather than waiting for perfect documentation.
* Judgment: Can determine whether results make sense based on patterns and business context.
* Persistence: Will search through tables, relationships, and outputs until the data story is clear.
* Ownership: Takes responsibility for producing reliable, explainable datasets.
* Analytical depth: Understands not just how to write SQL, but how to reason through data.
* Practical prototyping ability: Can quickly build usable datasets that help shape future warehouse or reporting solutions.


Responsibilities:
* Analyze complex enterprise data across multiple source systems to support reporting, analytics, and data warehouse development.
* Build prototype datasets, proof\-of\-concept queries, and exploratory data models to support new business requirements.
* Design and develop SQL\-based data marts, analytical datasets, and reusable query logic.
* Investigate undocumented databases to identify table relationships, keys, joins, business rules, and data lineage.
* Validate data outputs by applying business judgment, reconciliation techniques, and analytical reasoning.
* Identify data quality issues, inconsistencies, gaps, duplicates, and unexpected trends.
* Translate ambiguous business questions into structured SQL analysis and actionable findings.
* Partner with Product Owners, Business Systems Analysts, Data Analysts, and Data Engineering teams to clarify requirements and validate assumptions.
* Support enterprise data warehouse design by helping define source\-to\-target mappings, transformation rules, and analytical models.
* Document findings, data relationships, assumptions, and reusable query patterns for future team use.
* Mentor other team members on advanced SQL analysis, data investigation, and validation techniques.


Qualifications:
* 10\+ years of hands\-on SQL development and data analysis experience.
* Strong experience working with enterprise databases, data warehouses, data marts, and analytical datasets.
* Expert\-level SQL skills, including complex joins, CTEs, window functions, aggregation logic, performance tuning, and query optimization.
* Proven ability to investigate unfamiliar databases and infer relationships without complete documentation.
* Strong data intuition: ability to recognize when results are incomplete, duplicated, inflated, missing, or logically incorrect.
* Experience building prototype datasets or analytical models from raw operational source data.
* Strong understanding of data warehouse concepts, dimensional modeling, fact and dimension structures, and source\-to\-target mapping.
* Ability to work with ambiguous requirements and independently drive analysis toward clear conclusions.
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain data findings to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications*** Experience in enterprise data warehouse environments.
* Experience with healthcare, legal, financial, or other complex operational data domains.
* Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and modern data platforms.
* Experience supporting BI/reporting teams with curated datasets and data marts.
* Experience documenting data lineage, transformation rules, and business logic
* Exposure to tools such as SQL Server, Azure SQL, Snowflake, Databricks, Synapse, Oracle, or similar platforms.
* **Why Join Us:**
	+ Be part of a collaborative and innovative work environment.
	+ Opportunity for professional growth and development.
	+ Competitive salary and benefits package.
	+ Contribute to shaping the future of our software development processes. **Consilio’s True North Values**


	+ **Client Experience** \| Listen for the “why”. Clearly define success. Be accountable. Go the extra distance to create moments that matter.
	+ **Collaboration** \| Treat everyone with respect. Welcome diverse views. Partner across geography, generations, and teams. Rally around final decisions.
	+ **Innovation** \| Always be curious (ABC). Challenge the status quo. Experiment and fail forward. Build for the future.
	+ **Grit** \| Focus on what matters. Work with passion and persistence. Think like an owner. Deliver results you’re proud of.  

Consilio, LLC is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

The ServiceNow Architect is a senior technical leader responsible for the strategic design, governance, and continuous evolution of the organization's ServiceNow platform. This role owns the end\-to\-end architectural vision for ServiceNow — spanning platform configuration, enterprise integrations, workflow automation, and the adoption of ServiceNow's AI and intelligence capabilities — ensuring the platform delivers measurable value across the business.


The ServiceNow Architect serves as the primary technical authority for the platform and works in close partnership with enterprise architecture, IT operations, business process owners, and product teams to transform ServiceNow from an ITSM tool into a strategic enterprise workflow automation hub. This individual operates at the intersection of technical depth and business strategy, shaping how work gets done across the organization.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

**Platform Architecture \& Governance**
---------------------------------------

* Define standards for automation governance: approval workflows, SLA frameworks, notification architecture, and audit trail design.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Are you passionate about protecting the world's most recognized brands and ensuring customers can shop with confidence on Amazon? Join the Intellectual Property Protections (IPP) team — the central hub for addressing complex brand protection challenges across Amazon's global marketplace.  

The IPP team designs and builds high\-performance systems leveraging machine learning and cross\-functional collaboration to identify, prevent, and remediate intellectual property abuse on behalf of rights owners worldwide. As the single\-threaded owner for end\-to\-end brand protection solutions, IPP ingests and prioritizes critical brand pain points, conducts comprehensive root cause analysis, develops sustainable mechanisms, and drives continuous improvement across Amazon's brand protection ecosystem.  

  

We are seeking a strategic, experienced Senior Program Manager to own the strategy, execution, and cross\-organizational integration for Band Protections — turning reactive enforcement into proactive, scalable prevention that directly reduces brand abuse for rights owners globally. In this role, you will:  

* Develop and execute comprehensive strategies to address complex, high\-ambiguity brand protection challenges with senior leadership visibility
* Lead cross\-functional initiatives spanning Product, Engineering, Operations, Science, and Policy teams across multiple geographies
* Establish key mechanisms, dashboards, and self\-service tooling that eliminate manual dependencies and enhance Amazon's brand protection capabilities
* Influence roadmap prioritization across multiple organizations, operating as a thought leader in the IP protection space
* Drive clear communication channels and strategic stakeholder engagement for both internal teams and external brand partners globally
* This is a high\-impact, high\-visibility role requiring exceptional judgment, the ability to shape strategy from scratch, and comfort operating in ambiguity. You will work across 5\+ teams and multiple geographies, building solutions that protect millions of brands and strengthen the trustworthiness of Amazon's marketplace.

  

This is a global role requiring effective communication and understanding of the diverse needs of international brands, operational teams, and stakeholders across countries.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

1\. Identify and resolve ambiguity across organizational boundaries — scoping problems, proposing solutions, and driving alignment where no playbook exists.  

2\. Analyze defects trends, policy gaps, and process inefficiencies to design scalable mechanisms that support evolving business needs  

3\. Author and present program updates to senior leadership, translating complex cross\-org dependencies into crisp narratives and actionable decision points.  

4\. Manage competing priorities across regional teams, making trade\-off recommendations and surfacing the right inputs for leadership decisions.  

5\. Own complex enforcement decisions in ambiguous, high\-stakes situations, setting precedents that scale across geographies  

  

About the team  

The vision of Intellectual Property Protections (IPP) team is to ensure every Brand’s catalog (ASINs and offers) is clean with no IP infringements while minimizing friction for the Sellers. We do this by proactively identifying infringing content on ASINs and offers through various signals including Brand provided data, Seller behavior, Brand licensee relationships, Brand/Seller appeals, etc. We build highly transparent systems that communicate the impact of our protections clearly and unambiguously to the Brand Owner and earn their trust.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 5\+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 2\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.description:
By clicking the “Apply” button, I understand that my employment application process with Takeda will commence and that the information I provide in my application will be processed in line with Takeda’s Privacy Notice and Terms of Use. I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**OBJECTIVES / PURPOSE**


We are seeking a strong Senior Analyst to serve as a hands\-on contributor across Tableau dashboarding and commercial analytics within Takeda's GCC Commercial Insights \& Analytics (I\&A) organization in India. This role carries significant individual analytical ownership — building enterprise\-grade reporting and dashboards in Tableau while independently delivering mid\-to\-high complexity commercial analytics workstreams that inform global brand strategy. The Senior Analyst is a critical analytical contributor who drives the quality and depth of insights delivered to global brand teams and begins to shape the analytical direction of assigned workstreams.

* Own and independently deliver a portfolio of reporting and dashboard products in Tableau, and serve as a go\-to resource for visual analytics across assigned brands and indications.
* Independently deliver mid\-to\-high complexity commercial analytics workstreams — patient journey analyses, HCP segmentation, performance deep\-dives, and competitive assessments — that provide actionable, evidence\-based recommendations to global I\&A brand leads and commercial partners.
* Serve as an emerging analytical thought leader within the GCC team — contributing to methodology development, analytical best practices, and the informal mentoring of Analyst colleagues.

**ACCOUNTABILITIES**

**Reporting \& Dashboarding Excellence — Tableau**

* Design, build, and maintain Tableau dashboards that communicate brand performance, patient journey dynamics, HCP engagement, and field force activity to global stakeholders.
* Apply strong Tableau capabilities — LOD expressions, parameters and actions, table calculations, and Tableau Server/Cloud publishing — and follow data visualization best practices and design standards (layout, color, accessibility, interactivity, storytelling).
* Establish and monitor KPIs and metrics — patient shares, new starts, duration of therapy (DoT), adherence, source of business, and campaign effectiveness — across global markets, regions, and channels.
* Maintain data models, extracts, and refresh pipelines feeding dashboards to ensure accuracy, reliability, and performance.

**Commercial Analytics \& Insight Generation**

* Own end\-to\-end delivery of assigned performance analytics workstreams that track brand KPIs across global, regional, and country levels.
* Integrate and analyze diverse commercial data sources across markets — real\-world data (claims, EMR/EHR, lab data), specialty pharmacy, sales, and channel data — to generate comprehensive patient and HCP insights that support brand strategy and launch readiness.
* Develop and maintain business rules for processing raw patient\-level data, leveraging a strong understanding of data nuances, commercial context, and market knowledge to ensure analytical accuracy and consistency.
* Conduct advanced, self\-directed exploratory data analysis (EDA) and opportunity prospecting — moving beyond basic pulls (counts, topline, segmentation, time trends) to surface non\-obvious commercial opportunities and hypotheses.
* Lead custom reporting and complex ad hoc analysis requests with independent hypothesis formulation, rigorous methodology, and well\-documented, insight\-rich outputs.

**Stakeholder Collaboration \& Mentorship**

* Partner with GCC Managers and global I\&A brand leads to clarify requirements, align on scope, and synthesize findings into decision\-oriented visual stories with clear “so what” recommendations.
* Provide informal mentoring and quality guidance to Analyst colleagues, and contribute to team knowledge management (visualization standards, design patterns, reusable templates and query libraries).

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE**

**Education:**

* Bachelor's Degree required in Statistics, Data Science, Life Sciences, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field; Master's degree or MBA strongly preferred.

**Experience:**

* 4–5 years of experience in pharmaceutical commercial analytics or healthcare analytics, with demonstrated independent ownership of both analytics deliverables and reporting/dashboard development.
* Strong, hands\-on Tableau experience building and maintaining dashboards is required; exposure to Tableau Server/Cloud publishing is preferred and Tableau certification is a plus. Working knowledge of Power BI is a plus.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

The Opportunity


As a Staff Software Engineer, you will be a technical leader within a cross‑functional Agile team, responsible not only for building high‑quality software, but also for influencing design decisions, engineering standards, and best practices across the team.


You will work on complex, distributed systems and automation services that are foundational to Visa’s infrastructure reliability. You are expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, translate ambiguous requirements into robust technical solutions, and provide guidance to other engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and mentoring.

Ownership \& Design

* Take end‑to‑end ownership of features and services, from design and implementation through deployment and lifecycle support.
* Contribute to and influence system architecture, API design, and technology choices, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, and resilient.
* Participate actively in code reviews and design discussions, providing thoughtful feedback and driving alignment with engineering best practices.


Software Development

* Design, develop, test, and maintain high‑quality Java\-J2EE applications using modern frameworks (Spring Boot, Hibernate) and microservices architectures.
* Build and evolve responsive, production‑grade user interfaces using modern frontend frameworks (React, Angular, or Vue.js).

Delivery \& Operations

* Contribute to CI\-CD pipelines and automated delivery processes using tools such as Git, Jenkins, and containerized environments (Docker).
* Support production systems, participate in incident resolution, and contribute to continuous improvements in stability and operational excellence.
* Collaborate with peers across Global Network Engineering and Visa Technology teams to ensure smooth integration and delivery.
* Proactively identify technical risks, performance bottlenecks, and reliability gaps, and drive solutions to address them.


Collaboration \& Influence

* Work closely with Product, Architecture, SRE, Security, and QA teams to translate business and platform requirements into technical solutions.
* Provide technical mentorship to junior engineers through pairing, reviews, and knowledge sharing.
* Influence team‑level and org‑level engineering best practices, including observability, resiliency, and automation.


This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in the office will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.


Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.**Qualifications**


Basic Qualifications:


5\+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD, OR 8\+ years of relevant work experience.


Preferred Qualifications:


5\+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD, OR 8\+ years of relevant work experience.


5\+ years of relevant professional software engineering experience with a Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent practical experience with an advanced degree.


Proven ability to independently deliver complex software solutions in a production environment.


Experience working on highly available infrastructure‑focused systems.


Prior experience mentoring engineers or acting as a technical lead on projects.


Familiarity with observability, resiliency engineering, and automation in distributed systems.


The Skills You Bring


Strong, hands‑on experience with Java\-J2EE, Spring Boot, and related enterprise frameworks.


Solid experience building distributed systems using RESTful APIs and microservices architectures.


Proficiency in frontend development using JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern UI frameworks (React, Angular, or Vue.js).


Experience integrating AI\-ML or Generative AI capabilities into production software systems


Experience using AI‑powered tools to improve coding, debugging, testing, documentation, and refactoring while maintaining engineering rigor.


Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud‑native development patterns.


Strong understanding of software design patterns, data structures, and system design principles.


Experience with automation and testing frameworks (e.g., Selenium, REST Assured, Cypress, Groovy, Python).


Demonstrated ability to perform root cause analysis and drive resolution of complex production issues.


Strong communication skills and the ability to influence technical outcomes across teams.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**


Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

Whether in the cloud or on\-premises, RSA connects people with the digital resources they depend on everywhere they live, work, and play.
   

  

 For decades, RSA has pioneered many of the encryption, authentication, and identity federation technologies that still power the internet. And now RSA is transforming the industry yet again, paving the way for the future of digital identity through the RSA Unified Identity Platform; next\-generation hybrid and cloud solutions; the first ever and only multi\-functional, passwordless hardware authenticator; and a frictionless, mobile\-optimized experience for the modern workforce.  **who is this user, and should they be granted access?**

jobs.description:
Job Title : Senior Product Manager
 



 Location : Bangalore; (Full Time, Onsite)
 



**About Locus** 




 Battle\-tested in 350\+ deployments across 30\+ countries, Locus is an agentic Transportation Management System for all\-mile, all\-channel, trusted by enterprises like Unilever, Nestlé, and Siam Makro.
 



 The platform unifies orders, capacity, and carrier networks into one living plan, aligning planning, execution, and settlement so promises become proof. AI co\-pilots with guardrails surface risk early and recommend the next best move to protect SLAs and reduce empty miles.
 



 In 2025, Locus joined the Ingka Group (IKEA Retail) family, marking a major milestone in our journey. Backed by the scale and strength of IKEA, we continue to operate independently while accelerating our mission to make global supply chains faster, smarter, and more sustainable.
 



**Our Journey and Impact** 




 Since 2015, Locus has been on a mission to make logistics decision\-making intelligent, sustainable, and real\-world ready. Our platform has powered billions of deliveries across 30 \+ countries for global enterprises, driving measurable impact in cost savings, carbon reduction, and SLA performance. With the strength of the IKEA ecosystem behind us, we’re scaling that impact even further.
 



**Our Global Footprint** 




 Headquartered in Bangalore, with teams across the U.S., U.K., UAE, and Southeast Asia, Locus brings together 170 \+ engineers, designers, and problem\-solvers united by a single goal: to reinvent how the world moves goods.
 



**Traits We Value** 




 We look for people who are:
 


* **Global in mindset** 
 : curious about diverse markets and ideas.
* 
* **Unrelenting in drive** 
 : energized by complex challenges.
* 
* **Intelligent in approach** 
 : analytical, creative, and thoughtful.
* 
* **Dynamic in execution** 
 : adaptive and decisive in fast\-moving contexts.
* 
* **Exact in craft** 
 : detail\-oriented and committed to excellence.



  





**About the role** 




 Locus is rebuilding last\-mile delivery as a multi\-tenant SaaS platform. The DiSCO Mobile App is the driver\-facing surface — used by drivers, 2\-person crews, and hub\-ops staff across enterprise tenants (IKEA, Giant Tiger, and the long tail of Locus customers).
 



 The Senior PM will own one or more product modules end\-to\-end — Hub \& Depot Operations, Execution at Customer Stop, Returns \& Reverse Logistics, Multi\-Trip Shifts, or Workforce \& Auth — from scoping with domain PMs, through workflow design with UX, to release readiness with the engineering pod and customer\-onboarding teams.
 



 The role partners with the Principal PM on overall app vision and runs its modules independently.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Own a slice of the mobile app: scope it, write the spec, drive design partnership, shepherd it through engineering, land it in tenant rollouts.
* Author mobile workflow specs (Delivery / Pickup / Hub \& Depot / Returns) and the matching epic \+ story tickets in Jira.
* Coordinate with domain PMs (Execution, Hub Ops, Workforce, Order Management) to translate entity specs and design decisions into driver\-facing scenarios.
* Partner with UX on gap closure and with the mobile engineering pod on sequencing and delivery.
* Own one or more enterprise tenant rollouts — translating customer requirements into product changes vs. tenant config, and holding the line on what is product\-grade vs. one\-off.
* Uphold platform defaults: client\-agnostic architecture, point\-of\-use permissions, plain\-language UX, no over\-engineered enterprise theatre.



**What we're looking for** 



* 6\+ years in product management, including 3\+ years on enterprise SaaS or platform products. Mobile app PM experience is a strong plus.
* Shipped in domain\-heavy, multi\-team environments — comfortable reading entity specs, sequence diagrams, and engineering RFCs, not just user stories.
* Spec author. Can write a 3,000\-word workflow doc that engineering, design, and customer success can all build from.
* Strong opinions about driver / operator UX — has shipped for low\-context, high\-pressure mobile users (delivery, field service, frontline ops, warehousing).
* Jira\-as\-source\-of\-truth discipline: every scope decision is a ticket, every blocker is a link, every spec gap is a child story.
* Bias toward plain language, concrete examples, and decision\-by\-tradeoff over decision\-by\-framework.



**Nice to have** 



* Logistics / last\-mile / supply\-chain domain background.
* Multi\-tenant SaaS scoping experience (what's product vs. what's tenant config).
* Comfort with domain\-driven teams (DDD, event sourcing, entity\-first specs



  





**What We Offer** 




 Join Locus and become part of a visionary team that is redefining logistics through innovation and smart distribution. We provide competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a collaborative environment where your expertise will drive both your growth and that of the organization.
 



*Locus is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace.*

jobs.description:
**About Energy Exemplar**



In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar’s mission lies in ‘Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions’. Founded in 1999 in Adelaide, Australia, our award\-winning software portfolio encompassing the modeling and simulation platform PLEXOS®, Aurora, and Adapt2, is trusted by innovative organizations across the globe. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation.



Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include:


* *SaaS Company of the Year (2025\) – Global Business Tech Awards.*
* *Environmental Impact Award (2025\) – E\+E Leaders Awards.*
* *IPPAI (Independent Power Producers Association of India) Power Awards (2025\) \- Winners*
* *Finalist: Platts Global Energy Awards (2024\) – Grid Edge category*
* *Finalist: Reuters Global Energy Transition Awards (2024\) – Technologies of Change*
* *Top 50 Marketing Team (2024\) – Voted by the public at the ICON Awards.*


**How We Work**



Energy Exemplar is growing fast around 30% year on year and, that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move.



We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.



Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity \& Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.

**Key Accountabilities and Duties**


**Accountabilities**


* Reporting to Director of Datasets
* This role oversees production of energy market fundamental model components and standalone models working out of our Pune office using PLEXOS and Aurora

  


**Day to day duties**


* Lead a large team of energy data analysts (with between 1 to 5 years of experience)
* Responsible for ensuring the completion and delivery of accurate updates of specific fundamental data work products as part of PLEXOS and Aurora dataset development
* Responsible for leading power markets research, analyzing and manipulating data and processing data for input into power market models
* Benchmarking etc. end\-to\-end process of creation and upgrading of production cost models
* Responsible for maintaining large databases of energy related data. Data sources include data\-providers, industry publications, regulatory agencies and web research.
* Running PLEXOS and/or Aurora and interpreting output model results and energy balances
* Comparing models and reviewing preliminary forecast output results for inconsistencies to ensure deliveries meet product scopes and specifications
* Communicate to IDC Analyst team about market modelling best practices and implementing improvements to research and model development
* Problem solving and interpretation of market models and ability to detect errors and omissions
* Troubleshoot market models and intermediate work products for errors, omissions, and improvements.

Energy Exemplar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, identities, and abilities. Please let us know if you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process—we're here to support you in showcasing your full potential.


*Energy Exemplar respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal data you share during the recruitment process. This Candidate* *Privacy Notice* *explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you apply for a role with us.*

 eGovernments (eGov), is a pioneering tech\-for\-good organization that exists to drive exponential impact in public service delivery at speed \& scale. We are on a mission to enhance the ease of living for citizens by improving access to essential public services. Our work involves:

* **Fostering dynamic networks**

jobs.title: Business Process Architect
jobs.description:
**Project Role :** 
 Business Process Architect
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Analyze and design new business processes to create the documentation that guides the implementation of new processes and technologies. Partner with the business to define product requirements and use cases to meet process and functional requirements. Participate in user and task analysis to represent business needs.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 Retirement Planning Services
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 NA
   

  

**Minimum 3 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 As a Business Process Architect, a typical day involves analyzing and designing innovative business processes that enhance operational efficiency. This role requires creating detailed documentation to support the implementation of new processes and technologies. Collaboration with various business units is essential to define product requirements and develop use cases that align with organizational goals. Additionally, the role includes participating in user and task analysis to accurately represent and address business needs, ensuring that solutions are practical and effective in real\-world applications.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

* Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
* Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
* Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure alignment of business processes with strategic objectives.
* Continuously evaluate existing processes and recommend improvements to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
* Support junior team members by sharing knowledge and providing guidance on process design and documentation.
* Facilitate workshops and meetings to gather insights and feedback from stakeholders for process optimization.


 Professional \& Technical Skills:
   

  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Retirement Planning Services.
* FIS Platform Expertise: Deep mastery of FIS Omni products (including Omniplus, OmniScript, OmniAdminWeb, OmniAPI/OmniLink) paired with understanding of new FIS Retirement Platform (FRP).
* Must have strong hands\-on OmniScripting experience.
* Must possess a strong understanding of Omni's integration and communication with external front\-end applications.
* Plans and coordinates development items for OMNI solutions in an ASP hosted environment.
* Works with the business users to ensure that the OMNI solution supports the organization s business strategy.
* Develops Omni scripts in alignment with business and product priorities.
* Interfaces with FIS ASP team on technical matters as needed.
* Manages development risks, issues/problems and activity progress to ensure project goals, e.g., deadline, scope and quality are achieved. Assists with problem resolution or risk mitigation as needed.
* Works on development of customizing processes to meet business requirements, including design within FIS OMNI or systems integrations with third\-party products.
* Serves as OMNI liaison between technical and non\-technical teams, to ensure all project targets and requirements are met.
* Develops OMNI metrics and standards.
* Strong analytical skills to assess and design business processes that meet organizational needs.
* Excellent communication skills to effectively collaborate with stakeholders and document requirements.
* Ability to translate complex business needs into clear and actionable process documentation.
* Experience in conducting user and task analysis to ensure comprehensive understanding of business requirements.
* Skilled in partnering with business units to define product requirements and use cases.


 Additional Information:
   

  

* The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in Retirement Planning Services.
* Understanding on FRP modules
* Assists with coaching junior script developers.
* Other related duties assigned as needed
* This position is based at our Bengaluru office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.
